comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
An eight-item Memorial Album consisting of eight adorably fluffy, fuzzy little kitty cats. Awwww, kitties. Ahem... the pet deeds are the actual items registered to your Album; each deed can be obtained from the Trainer NPC after completing an appropriate quest, or by purchasing the deeds from players who have them for sale. (If you buy them, equip/de-equip the deed and it will register.)

The quests/deeds are:

The tale of a cat from the city of water - randomly gives Cat (Gray) / Cat (Light Purple) / Cat (White) / Cat (Dark Purple)
The heartless ocelot - gives Ocelot (Brown) (r3 Quarters required if you plan to buy and equip/de-equip this pet for MA)
The Cat, a Testimony of Appreciation - gives Siamese Cat (White)
The Young Girl and the Cat - gives Persian Cat (White)
The Tortoise-shell Cat - gives Calico Cat (3-Colored)

As is often the case in UWO, the beginner-level quest Cat can be the hardest one to acquire since its four different colored deeds drop at random. Cats do enjoy being stubborn, don't they?

When finished, you may report to: Veronica Franco(Ragusa)
The reward is Cat Ears

Meow. Um... cheers.
